title: Dispatch from a component
summary: A component can dispatch an action in response to a user action.
introduction: A component can dispatch an action in response to a user action. Your task: Connect a reset button to a reset action.
learningObjectives: Connect a reset button to a reset action.
Explain the example for dispatch from a component

blocks.text: A component can dispatch an action in response to a user action. The reducer remains responsible for changing shared state.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.

items: `dispatch` sends an action into the store. Merely making an action object does not update state.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Dispatch the created action object, not the creator function itself.
